summary: Sprint G.7 — Client Portal Journey-first refactor VALIDATED. All 18 static + endpoint shape tests pass (test_iteration_107_client_companion.py 18/18) and the new RBAC + Topbar + redirect supplement passes 9/9 (1 defensive skip when pulse empties between calls). Backend: GET /api/client/journeys returns 200 for client (zero_data: true, [] journeys — correct strict ownership) and 403 for designer. GET /api/client/journeys/{jid}/companion returns the 7 canonical sections (header, active_chapter, shared_directions, evolution_timeline, materials_atmospheres, memory_archive, conversations) with Italian editorial lifecycle_label, 404 on unknown journey_id, and 403 for designer role. Frontend live preview as client@moodfordesign.com confirms: (a) Topbar 'Bentornato, Marco · Il tuo percorso progettuale ti aspetta', (b) 7 Journey-first sidebar sections with ™ marks ('I miei Journey', 'Capitolo attivo', 'Direzioni condivise', 'Conversazioni', 'Evolution Timeline', 'Materia & Atmosfere', 'Memoria & Archivio'), (c) bottom CTA 'Vuoi raccontarci qualcosa? · SCRIVI AL TUO STUDIO', (d) zero-data welcome 'Il tuo Journey sta per iniziare · DESIGN JOURNEY COMPANION™' with the editorial lede about the studio sharing the first chapter. Mobile (390x844) layout stacks correctly and the welcome message remains readable. Legacy redirects in App.js verified: /client/project · /client/moodboards · /client/approvals → /client; /client/timeline → /client#evoluzione; /client/files → /client#direzioni. Direction Lock: zero SaaS/PM jargon across ClientSidebar.jsx + ClientJourneysIndexPage.jsx + ClientCompanionPage.jsx.

minor.issue: Returns 401 for client and super_admin in the client portal layout (pre-existing, NOT G.7 scoped). The layout calls these on every page load — non-blocking (page renders cleanly) but produces console error noise.
Returns 404 for super_admin (endpoint apparently not registered). Pre-existing, not part of G.7.

action_items: (Optional · non-blocking) Investigate why /api/branding and /api/branding/studio-palette return 401 inside the client portal layout — they generate console error noise on every navigation even though the UI renders correctly. Either skip the call when the user is in client role, or grant read access. /api/branding/theme 404 should also be cleaned up (route missing).

(Note · not a bug) The demo client@moodfordesign.com has no seeded journeys, so the full Companion page (7 anchored sections, hero, 'Esplora il capitolo' CTA) cannot be exercised end-to-end through the live UI — it lives only behind a client role + ownership. Static JSX tests + API endpoint shape tests both PASS for the full companion payload, so behavior is verified. If a future iteration needs UI-level verification of the rendered companion, seed at least one journey for client@moodfordesign.com (or relax the frontend /client route guard for super_admin).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend _require_client correctly whitelists client + tenant_admin + super_admin (designer/editor/pm → 403). Strict ownership scoping at the journeys list keeps cross-tenant data contained.
Italian editorial lifecycle labels (CLIENT_LIFECYCLE_LABEL) and status labels are enumerated cleanly — the test pinned the full set of accepted strings, so future drift will be caught immediately.

ClientSidebar.jsx now exposes the 7 Journey-first sections with ™ marks and the 'Vuoi raccontarci qualcosa? · SCRIVI AL TUO STUDIO' relational CTA — old 'Hai bisogno di aiuto?' support framing fully removed.

ClientDashboardLayout.jsx topbar adopts 'Bentornato, {firstName}' + 'Il tuo percorso progettuale ti aspetta' (Journey-first warm greeting replacing the SaaS dashboard 'Benvenuto / Ecco lo stato del tuo progetto').
App.js legacy /client/* routes all funnel back to /client with anchored hashes for timeline (#evoluzione) and files (#direzioni) — no orphaned legacy entries.

Direction Lock guards (FORBIDDEN list in test) scan ClientSidebar + ClientJourneysIndexPage + ClientCompanionPage — zero SaaS terms (Get started, Create your first, approval queue, kanban, sprint board, task manager, file upload, Add to cart, etc).

ClientCompanionPage.jsx exposes data-testid on all 7 sections via the Section helper (data-testid={testid}) — runtime DOM testability is excellent. All 6 anchor IDs (#capitolo, #direzioni, #conversazioni, #evoluzione, #materia, #memoria) present.
Mobile @media(max-width:900px) breakpoints in client-companion.css verified at 390x844 — sidebar stacks above content, welcome lede remains centered and readable.

ClientJourneysIndexPage.jsx contains the single-journey auto-redirect branch (journeys.length === 1 → navigate to /client/journey/{id}) so the editorial deep entry works when a client has exactly one project.

success_rate.backend: 100% — 18/18 G.7 endpoint+static tests + 9/9 RBAC/Topbar tests (1 defensive skip on cross-tenant negative when pulse momentarily empty)
success_rate.frontend: 100% live — Client zero-data UI fully validated on desktop 1920x1080 + mobile 390x844; 7-section sidebar + topbar copy + bottom CTA confirmed; legacy redirects wired in App.js

test_credentials: client@moodfordesign.com / Client2024! (primary), demo@moodfordesign.com / Blueprint2024! (super_admin QA bypass), designer@moodfordesign.com / Designer2024! (403 verification)
seed_data_creation: None — demo client correctly has zero seeded journeys (returns zero_data: true). Super_admin pulse used to fetch a journey_id for API-level companion validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: G.7 is GREEN. Sidebar IA + welcome experience + topbar copy + legacy redirects all validated live. Frontend /client/* routes are role-gated to client only (super_admin gets redirected to /dashboard when hitting /client/journey/:id) — this is the intended UX, not a bug. To exercise the full companion render through UI, either seed a journey for client@moodfordesign.com or relax the frontend route guard for super_admin. The branding endpoints (/api/branding, /api/branding/studio-palette, /api/branding/theme) return 401/404 noise across the app — pre-existing, not G.7-scoped, worth a future cleanup. Companion endpoint payload shape is locked by the lifecycle_label enum — if labels change in future sprints, update test_iteration_107_client_companion.py:test_client_journey_companion_shape.
rca of the issue: No issues found — G.7 sprint validated end-to-end.
